description: This file defines a Pinia store for managing shopping cart and product data in a frontend application. It includes state variables for products, cart, loading/error states, and order confirmation, along with actions to load data, modify the cart, and perform checkout. It imports external API functions and contains internal logic for handling local storage and UUID generation.

methods.name: loadProducts
methods.description: Fetches product list from API and updates state; handles errors gracefully.

methods.name: loadCart
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's cart using a persisted cart ID, handling errors by initializing an empty cart.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart via API call.

methods.name: updateItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart.

methods.name: doCheckout
methods.description: Performs checkout with user details, updates order confirmation, and resets cart.

ctags.name: Cart
ctags.pattern: /^import { listProducts, getCart, addToCart, updateCartItem, removeCartItem, checkout, type Produc/

ctags.name: Product
ctags.pattern: /^import { listProducts, getCart, addToCart, updateCartItem, removeCartItem, checkout, type Produc/
